text: Experiment 6 (2026-11-11), four more recovery arms on the 27 experiment-4 mocks (truth [α/Fe]=+0.2, age 3.59 Gyr, [Fe/H]=−0.2), 108/108 valid. Bias = recovered − truth, medians over 3 seeds, [α/Fe] dex / age Gyr. A, C and N free, full range: [α/Fe] −0.004…−0.001, age −0.23…−0.04 over the nine injections; truth inside 16–84% in 27/27 for [α/Fe], age, [Fe/H], C/Fe; N/Fe low by 0.05–0.07 (inside 9/27). B, plain grid, red end cut at rest 5015.2 Å (median red edge of the five LEGA-C test galaxies without Mg b; zero Mg b pixels): C +0.30 → −0.295 / +0.78; C +0.15, N +0.30 → −0.219 / −0.31; C +0.30, N +0.60 → −0.393 / −0.62. C, C and N free, same cut: [α/Fe] −0.020…−0.017 (truth inside 19/27; the zero-injection control is −0.017), age −0.23…−0.08; fitted C/Fe positive for all 18 C-positive mocks, truth inside 27/27. D, plain grid, carbon mask (CN4150, G4300, Fe4383, C4668): C +0.30, N +0.60 → −0.329 / +0.16 against −0.340 / −0.25 unmasked; C +0.30 → −0.225 / +0.55 against −0.250 / +0.91; [α/Fe] truth inside 2/27 in both. Differences from the real fits: the mask moved real LEGA-C [α/Fe] by +0.13 (61 galaxies) against 0.01–0.03 in the mocks; real no-Mg-b galaxies fit C/Fe −0.21…−0.26 in 4/5, the mocks never do. Mocks inject and fit with the same alf response prescription, one SFH. First 135-galaxy checkpoint (results/chronometer-135-2026-11-10, C and N free, worker-reported, final tables pending): median [α/Fe] +0.21 for the 61 with Mg b (baseline +0.08), −0.05 for the 74 without (baseline −0.16); age–redshift slope all 135 +0.97 Gyr per unit z (baseline −1.55), Mg b group −2.76, no-Mg-b group −2.07. Launched: Mg b-cut refits of the 61 (C/N free and plain) and a residual stack of the 135 fits by rest wavelength (experiment 7).
